name: hero-share-app
blurb: Mobile app landing hero with warm gradient backdrop and floating gallery.
description: App-store focused hero with warm red gradient (radial overlay), responsive nav, headline, dual download buttons (App Store/Play Store), and three floating image cards on scroll reveal. Uses TimelineAnimation for scroll-triggered stagger.
use_when: Mobile app launch landing page emphasizing social sharing or community features.
avoid_when: Requires TimelineAnimation scroll handler and Observer API.
a11y: Navigation and CTA buttons focusable. Gallery images have alt text. No prefers-reduced-motion guard.
